detailExpansion.definition: Source details absent from the indexed numeric FMA concepts (including extension bases), canonical English names and comparable object IDs of the three preceding references, also excluding matching available OBJ hashes. Exact duplicate source positions and triangulated faces are counted once. This index comparison is not a claim of anatomical novelty against references without a complete concept crosswalk. Named source spaces and regions are not presented as additional tissues.

classification.method: Release FMA2Obj memberships; explicit authored neural, vascular and musculoskeletal-support names provide study groupings, with visceral context preserved. Residual anatomy stays in the organs study layer without claiming every residual region is an organ. No anatomical relationship is invented.

lodPolicy.high: Every non-degenerate source triangle and its coordinates retained; no geometric smoothing, subdivision or decimation. Only documented exactly zero-area source faces incident to an absent normal are omitted. Zero-normal corners on valid source triangles are split and receive their own source-oriented face normal; valid authored normals remain unchanged apart from normalization.
